description: Read one A2A agent: every skill its card declares, capabilities, protocol version, health, documentation and the registries that list it, with their licenses. Take the key from a2a_agent_search. The same row as the list plus what the card declares: every skill, the `capabilities` object, the protocol version as written, the documentation and icon URLs, and when we first saw it. Cached for 60 seconds; a MAT catalog read, like the list.

chave.description: Agent key (`key`) from a2a_agent_search, usually the card's domain.

retry_key.description: Optional retry key, up to 80 ASCII characters; same read for five minutes.

name: a2a_agent
title: A2a agent
